actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation').parameters({operation: 'search#Recipients', parameters: {term: term || '', mode: mode || 'email'}}).call()?.result || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.optionList || []))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation').parameters({operation: 'send#Compose', parameters: {fromValue: fromValue || '', emailMessageId: emailMessageId || null, toJson: toJson || '[]', ccJson: ccJson || '[]', bccJson: bccJson || '[]', subject: subject ?? '', body: body ?? '', bodyText: bodyText || null, quoteHtml: quoteHtml || null, parentEmailMessageId: parentEmailMessageId || null, isForward: String(isForward) === 'true', parentCommEventId: parentCommEventId || null, replyToSenderOnly: String(replyToSenderOnly) === 'true', uploadsJson: uploadsJson || null, recordEntity: recordEntity || null, recordId: recordId || null, scheduledSendDate: scheduledSendDate ? new Date(Number(scheduledSendDate)) : null, holdSeconds: holdSeconds != null && holdSeconds !== '' ? Number(holdSeconds) : null, archiveThread: String(archiveThread) === 'true', threadStore: threadStore || null, threadId: threadId || null, clientRef: clientRef || null}}).call()?.result || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {mode: out.mode, emailMessageId: out.emailMessageId, statusId: out.statusId, sent: out.sent, sendError: out.sendError, scheduledSendDate: out.scheduledSendDate, communicationEventIdList: out.communicationEventIdList, message: out.message, duplicate: out.duplicate === true})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.send#DueDrafts').parameter('emailMessageId', emailMessageId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {sentCount: out.sentCount, failedCount: out.failedCount})
